audit_items.proof_trace: Deduplication uses only Index as map key, not validating KzgCommitments equality. When multiple sidecars with same Index but different commitments exist (from malicious peers), the last one silently overwrites earlier ones, violating bijectivity.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker-controlled peers send sidecars with duplicate Index but conflicting KzgCommitments. Storage accepts both (individually verified). On reconstruction, map deduplication discards one arbitrarily, producing inconsistent commitment arrays that break semantic equivalence.
